name: POS Return Policy
description: The POS Return Period Control module allows you to define a specific number of days during which POS orders can be refunded or returned. After the configured period expires, the system automatically restricts returns and notifies the user, ensuring better control over your store refund policies.
summary: The POS Return Period Control module helps businesses efficiently manage and enforce product return policies within the Odoo Point of Sale system. It allows administrators to define a specific number of days during which customers can return or refund purchased items. Once the configured return period expires, the system automatically restricts further returns and notifies the cashier, preventing unauthorized refunds. The module also displays the valid return duration on printed POS receipts, ensuring clear communication with customers and reducing misunderstandings. By automating return validations, this tool enhances operational accuracy, strengthens policy compliance, and promotes transparency across all sales points. In addition, the module simplifies store management by minimizing manual oversight and eliminating errors related to delayed refunds. It helps businesses maintain consistent refund practices across multiple POS sessions and locations. The clear alerts and printed messages improve staff awareness and customer satisfaction, making return handling faster, fairer, and more reliable.
